bundle.shortDescription: Unofficial, local-first study app for the CEH v13 exam
bundle.longDescription: ShieldUp is an independent, unofficial study aid for the CEH v13 (312-50) exam: study planner, spaced-repetition flashcards, practice quizzes and reference sheets. It is not affiliated with, sponsored by or endorsed by EC-Council. All progress stays on your device.
